## Mantis Shrimp Lord (CR 14)

**XP** 38,400  
N Large vermin (aquatic)  
**Init** +6; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., incredible sight; Perception +2  


**Defense**


**AC** 27, touch 15, flat-footed 21 (+6 Dex, +12 natural, -1 size)  
**hp** 273 (21d8+105)  
**Fort** +17, **Ref** +13, **Will** +9  
**Immune** mind-affecting effects; **Resist** sonic 20  


**Offense**


**Speed** 50 ft.; swim 40 ft.  
**Melee** 2 pincers +22/+17/+12 (3d6+8 plus grab and sonic burst)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** sonic burst, speedy pincers  


**Statistics**


**Str** 26, **Dex** 23, **Con** 20, Int—, **Wis** 15, **Cha** 16  
**Base Atk** +15; **CMB** +24 (+28 grapple); **CMD** 40 (52 vs. trip)  


**Special Abilities**


**Devastating Pincers (Ex)** A mantis shrimp lord can make iterative attacks with its pincers and ignores the first 20 points of hardness when attacking objects.  

**Incredible Sight (Ex)** A mantis shrimp lord’s eyes pick up colors well beyond those visible to humans, and it can see perfectly in all light conditions, including supernatural darkness. As long as the mantis shrimp lord is not blinded, it is treated as having blindsight 60 feet.  

**Sonic Burst (Ex)** A mantis shrimp lord attacks with such extreme speed that its pincers issue a concussive blast of light and force when they snap closed. Each time a mantis shrimp lord makes a pincer attack, whether it hits or misses, each creature in a 20-foot-radius burst centered on the attack’s target takes 2d6 points of sonic damage and must succeed at a DC 25 Fortitude save or be stunned 1 for 1 round. A creature that succeeds at this save is immune to the stun effect from additional sonic bursts from that mantis shrimp lord until the vermin’s next turn, but it still takes sonic damage from additional sonic bursts. The mantis shrimp lord is immune to this effect. The save DC is Constitution-based.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** warm water  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** none
